description: Update message state without modifying content (idempotent — safe to retry). action=`mark-read`/`mark-unread` toggles the `isRead` flag on a single message by `id`. action=`flag` sets a follow-up flag with optional `dueDateTime`/`startDateTime` (ISO 8601). action=`unflag` clears the flag. action=`complete` marks the flag as done. Flag/unflag/complete accept either `id` (single) or `ids` (batch array) — batch operations use Graph `$batch` for efficiency. Returns status confirmation per message.

id.description: Single message ID (required for mark-read/mark-unread, or use instead of ids for flag actions)

ids.description: Array of message IDs for batch flag/unflag/complete operations

name: update-email
